verdict.description: clean when no blocking and no should-fix finding remains on either axis; nits alone are still clean.

summary.description: One line per axis: total findings and the worst issue within that axis. Do not rank across axes.

standards.description: Findings on the Standards axis: documented-standard breaches and baseline smells.

id.description: Stable short handle for this finding, e.g. S1, S2. Reuse the same id across rounds when re-reporting the same defect.

file.description: Repository-relative path. Never wrap or abbreviate it.

finding.description: The full finding: what is wrong, the standard or spec line it breaches, and the evidence. Prose, as long as it needs to be.

requires_design_decision.description: True when remediation requires choosing between designs with real trade-offs, rather than applying a determinate fix.

spec.description: Findings on the Spec axis: missing requirements, scope creep, and wrong implementations of requirements.

id.description: Stable short handle for this finding, e.g. P1, P2. Reuse the same id across rounds when re-reporting the same defect.

file.description: Repository-relative path. Never wrap or abbreviate it.

finding.description: The full finding, quoting the spec line it rests on.

requires_design_decision.description: True when remediation requires choosing between designs with real trade-offs, rather than applying a determinate fix.
